s: Dine sechita beshabbat ubo k"ch seipim: hassochet zetim lehotzi mehem shemen, o anabim lehotzi mehen yayin — chayyab, mippene shemmepareq hammashqeh mehapperi, ukebar nitbaer besiman sh"h shekkol hampareq okel o mashqeh mimmaqom shennitkassa bo — hare zeh toledet haddash. Abal shear perot — muttar lesochotan min hattora lehotzi memehem, mippene shekkol me perot en alehem torat mashqeh, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanabim bilbad, ella torat okel alehem, vahare zeh kemaprid okel meokel, sheen bo mishshum mepareq, kemo shennitbaer sham. Umiddibre soperim asur lischot apillu tutim verimmonim, mippene shemmiqtzat bene adam sheyyesh lahem harbeh tutim verimmonim hem sochatin otan leshem mashqeh kezetim vaanabim, veillu hayu ken harbeh lishar bene adam — hayu gam ken regilin lesochotam leshem mashqeh. Lepikak, kol mi shessochatan leshem mashqeh — moelet machashabto lihyot shem mashqeh alehem middibre soperim, veen omerim "botla dato etzel kol adam". Veken otam agasim (sheqqorin barny"s bilshon ashkenaz) shergilin lesochotan leshem mashqeh bemiqtzat meqomot — asur lesochotan beshabbat bekol haolam kullo, sheepshar sheim haya lekol haolam harbeh mehem kol kak kemo sham — hayu gam ken sochatin otam leshem mashqeh. Veken kol kayyotze beperot ellu. Abal shear perot sheen derek haolam lesochotan leshem mashqeh, dehaynu lishtot memehem mechamat tzama o taanug, ap sheyyesh lahem harbeh mehem, vaapillu regilin lesochotan lirpua — en alehem shem mashqeh bishbil kak, apillu middibre soperim, umuttar lesochotan beshabbat, mippene shehu kemaprid okel meokel. Veap al pi shezzeh hassochatan mitkavven leshem mashqeh — botla dato etzel kol adam. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom shennahagu lischot ezeh peri leshem mashqeh — hare dino sham ketutim verimmonim, veasur lesochoto beshabbat beoto maqom leshem mashqeh, shello botla daat zeh hassochet, kevan shekkol anshe meqomo osin ken bechol. Abal bishar meqomot muttar lesochoto, hoil veen regilin lesochoto leshem mashqeh ap sheyyesh lahem harbeh mimmennu. Veyesh omerim shekkol happerot asur lesochotan middibre soperim letzorek memehem, shekkevan shezzeh hassochet dato al memehem lishtotam mechamat tzama o mechamat taanug (o apillu lirpua) — hare hem chashubim mashqeh middibre soperim, veen omerim "botla dato etzel kol adam" (abal im dato kede letabbel bahem hammaakal — muttar, kemo sheyyitbaer). Abal im eno sochet ella lematteq happeri velo letzorek hammashqeh — muttar bishar kol happerot. Vaapillu shoteh hammashqeh hannischat — muttar, kevan sheeno mitkavven bischitato bishbil hashshetiyya. Chutz mittutim verimmonim vekayyotze bahen (mehapperot shemmiqtzat bene adam sheyyesh lahen harbeh sochatin otam leshem mashqeh kezetim vaanabim, veillu haya ken harbeh lishar bene adam hayu regilin gam ken lesochotan leshem mashqeh), shebbahem aseru lischot apillu kede lematteqan bilbad, gezera shemma yischot gam ken letzorek hammashqeh (kemo sheosin otan bene adam sheyyesh lahem harbeh mehem). Veken nohagin lehachamir bimqomot harbeh. Abal haiqqar kasbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom shennahagu lehachamir — en leshannot:

Vekol zeh lischot, abal limtzotz bepiv hammashqeh min happerot — yesh mattirin apillu mizzetim vaanabim, mippene sheen derek sechita bekak, ubotla dato etzel kol adam. Veyesh omerim sheap al pi ken asur middibre soperim, kemo sheaseru linaq bepiv min habbehema ap al pi shemmepareq kilachar yad hu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"ch. Vegam yesh lachush lechiyyub chattat, ki shemma en zeh niqra mepareq kilachar yad kemo hayyoneq mehabbehema, lepi shellinaq hu shinnuy gamur, sheen derek kelal linaq ella lachalob, abal metzitzat perot enah shinnuy kol kak, ki regilin laasot ken lipamim. Vaapillu perot sheissur sechitatan hu middibre soperim — asur limtzotz, kemo zetim vaanabim, shello chalequ chakamim bigzeratam. Vehu haddin benoten pat beyayin o basar bemaraq, sheasur limtzotz otam, ap al pi sheen issur bischitatan ella middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer. Velaken asur limtzotz qeneh hatztzuqe"r, sheddino ketutim verimmonim vekayyotze bahem. Vehamminhag lehaqel apillu bezetim vaanabim, kasbara harishona. Vehammachmir apillu bepat ubasar — tabo alayv beraka. Umikkol maqom, bishar perot chutz mizzetim vaanabim — yesh lehaqel, ki yesh tzad lehaqel bimtzitzat perot velomar shedderek akilatan kak hu, vekol shehu derek akila eno meen melaka kelal, veap chakamim lo gazeru bo, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"t beborer okel mittok happesolet:

Mashqin shezzabu beshabbat mealehem mizzetim vaanabim — asurim ad laereb, gezera shemma yischot beyadayim kede lishtotan hayyom im yihyu muttarim. Vaapillu im hazzetim vehaanabim hen omedin laakila — chosheshin shemma yimmalek alehen lesochotan leshem mashqin, kemo shehu derek rob hazzetim vehaanabim. Abal mashqin shezzabu mittutim verimmonim vekayyotze bahen, im hen omedim laakila — hammashqin muttarim, veen chosheshim shemma yimmalek alehem lemashqin, veim hen omedin lemashqin — hammashqin asurim:

Zetim vaanabim shennitrassequ mibbeod yom — mashqin hayyotzein mehen beshabbat muttarin, mittaam shennitbaer besiman rn"b. Vaapillu lo nitrassequ mibbeod yom, im yesh yayin begigit shehaanabim betokah, ap al pi shehaanabim mitbaqqeim beshabbat baggigit veyotze mehen od yayin — muttar lishtot miggigit zo beshabbat, shekkol meat yayin hayyotze mehaanabim beshabbat mitbattel beshishshim beyayin shehaya kebar baggigit. Veap al pi shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", shelleachar hashshabbat yihyeh muttar belo bittul, mikkol maqom kevan sheyyayin zeh hayyotze beshabbat lo haya nikkar meolam qodem shennitareb velo haya alayv shem yayin meolam (veayyen beyoreh dea siman qk"g ematay chal alayv shem yayin) — lo chal alayv shem "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" ad leachar shekkebar nitbattel. Velo ameru she"dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" eno batel, ella keshehaissur been mittechilla, vechal alayv shem "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", veachar kak nitareb. Vaapillu im natenu anabim shelemim begigit zo beshabbat venitbaqqeu beyayin bo bayyom — muttar lishtot yayin mehaggigit mittaam zeh. Abal lekattechilla asur litten anabim shelemim beyayin beshabbat kede sheyyitbaqqeu veyazub yenam, mishshum issur sechita. Veap sheeno sochet beyadayv mammash — mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim:

Chartzannim vezagim shennatan alehem mayim laasot temad — muttar limshok mehem beshabbat velishtot. Vaapillu lo natan mayim vehayyayin mitmatztzeh vezab meelayv — muttar lishtoto, kevan shekkebar nitrasseq mibbeod yom:

Muttar lischot eshkol shel anabim letok haqqedera sheyyesh bah tabshil kede letaqqen (ayyen siman tq"h) haokel, shekkol mashqeh habba laokel keokel hu chashub, veen alayv shem mashqeh kelal, vahare zeh kemaprid okel meokel. Abal im en bah okel — asur lischot letokah, ap al pi sheatid leareb bah okel, ubishbil kak hu sochet letokah yayin zeh kade letaqqen ulematteq et haokel sheyyitten bah achar kak sheyyoklennu im yayin zeh, vahare zeh mashqeh habba laokel ukeokel hu chashub, mikkol maqom kevan shebbishat sechitat hayyayin en bah okel adayin, veen haddabar nikkar kelal shehu ba letaqqen okel — asur middibre soperim:

Veken haddin betutim verimmonim vekayyotze bahem, abal shear perot, ap ledibre haoserim lesochotan letzorek memehem, mikkol maqom im eno sochatan ella kede letabbel hammaakal bememehem — hare zeh muttar, ap al pi sheen sham okel betok hakkeli shessochatan letoko, mippene shebbishat sechitatan yodeim hakkol shessochatan lematteq haokel velo leshem mashqeh, sheen derek kelal lesochotan leshem mashqeh:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beperot hareuyim laakila, abal perot sheenan reuyim laakila — asur lesochotan ledibre hakkol apillu letok hookalim, shekkeshessochet peri sheeno rauy laakila — eno maprid okel meokel, ella okel mippesolet, veyesh bazeh mishshum mepareq, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"h, vegam mishshum borer okel mittok happesolet, apillu rotzeh leekol lealtar, shello hittiru libror okel mippesolet beyado kede leekol lealtar ella mippene shedderek akila kak hu littol haokel beyado min happesolet veleekol, veeno meen melaka, abal lischot veleekol — eno derek akila ella derek melaka:

Veken asur lischot habboser, dehaynu anabim shello higgiu lekappol hallaban, apillu letok hookalin, mippene sheeno rauy laakila, vekipsolet hu legabbe yayin hannischat mimmennu. Ulepi shello noda lanu shiur pol hallaban — asur lischot anabim letok okalim ad sheyyihyu reuyim laakila lerob bene adam. Veyesh mi shemmattir lischot habboser letok haokel (veen tzarik lomar bishar perot sheenan reuyim laakila, vaapillu lesochotan leshem mashqin muttar lehammattirin bishar perot). Veyesh lehachamir kasbara harishona:

Tappuchim dinam kishar perot. Vaapillu limonim en dinam ketutim verimmonim ella kishar perot, shemmuttar lesochotan letzorek memehen apillu leshem mashqeh ledibre hammattirim. Uledibre haoserim muttar al kol panim lesochotan letzorek okel, dehaynu letabbel hammaakal bememehen vekayyotze bazeh. Veap al pi shebbeotan meqomot sheyyesh lahem harbeh mehem hem sochatim otan letzorek memehen — en dinam ketutim verimmonim bishbil kak apillu beotan meqomot, lepi sheenan sochatin memehen leshem mashqeh ella letzorek okel. Vaapillu im nohagin lesochotan letok mayim lishtot — muttar, kevan sheen derek lishtotan lebaddan. Umikkol maqom, ledibre haoserim lischot shear perot letzorek memehen leshem mashqeh — asur lischot beshabbat limonim o shear perot letok mayim o shear mashqin lishtotan, lepi shello ameru ella mashqeh habba laokel hu keokel, velo habba lammashqeh:

Vekol zeh belimonim chadashim, abal hakkebushim bemelach vechometz o beme melach, veken shear perot viraqot hakkebushim veken hashshelaqot — asur ledibre hakkol lesochotan letzorek memehen, ella letzorek gupan letaqqenam laakila al yede kak, sheaz en bo mepareq, kevan sheeno tzarik kelal ledabar hammitpareq, dehaynu memehen. Veim sechatan letzorek memehen — patur min hattora, sheap al pi shemmemehen hayu mashqin gemurim qodem shennibleu bahen, kegon shennikbeshu o nishlequ bemayim o yayin vechometz vekayyotze bahen mishshear mashqin, kevan sheakshav hen nischatin meokalin — torat okel alehen, vahare zeh kemaprid okel meokel. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim asur lesochotan letzorek memehem, hoil vehayu mashqin gemurim qodem laken. Mah sheen ken beperot chayyin, shemmeme sechitatan lo haya alehem shem mashqeh meolam, lepikak muttar lesochotan ledibre hammattirin:

Muttar lischot kebashim ushelaqot letzorek memehen letok qedera sheyyesh bah okel kede letaqqeno. Abal im adayin en bah okel — asur lischot letokah ap al pi sheatid leareb bah okel, mittaam shennitbaer lemala:
Muttar lesochotan letok hammuryas, mippene shehu chashub okel, abal letok hammashqin asur lesochotan:
Hassochet dag letzorek tziro — dino kesochet kebashim ushelaqot letzorek memehen:
Tappuach o shear peri mebushshal — muttar lesochoto lehotzi mimmennu mah sheyyesh bo, shehare hu sochet kol haokel mimmennu velo kede lehotzi mimmennu memayv:

Hashsheleg vehabbarad vekol kayyotze bahem — asur lerasseq otam beyadayim, dehaynu leshabberam lachatikot daqqot kede sheyyazubu memehen, mishshum sheddomeh limlaka, shebbore mayim hallalu. Abal noten hu letok kos shel yayin o mayim bimot hachamma kede letzanneno, vehem nimmochim mealehem, veeno choshesh. Veken muttar lehannicham bachamma o keneged hammedura, bemaqom sheen yekolim lehitchammem sham ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo, vehem nipsharim sham mealehem. Veyesh omerim shello hittiru ella litten letok hakkos, shehannimmoach eno been lebaddo ella meorab beyayin o bemayim shebbakkos, abal keshehannimmoch hu been lebaddo — asur apillu bediabad, mittaam shennitbaer besiman shy"ch. Ukebar nitbaer sham shehaiqqar kasbara harishona, ella shellekattechilla nohagin lehachamir:

Lo aseru ella keshemmitkavven lerasseq bishbil sheyyazubu memayv, abal muttar lishbor chatika mimmennu, apillu im yazubu qetzat mayim al yede zeh, sheddabar muat hu veeno chashub kelum. Veod, sheeno mitkavven lekak, veeno "pesiq resheh". Veod, shehem holekim leibbud (veenan domin kelal lischitat perot haomedim lemashqim, sheen hammashqeh hannischat holek leibbud, velaken en ligzor kelal al zeh mippene zeh):

Muttar leshabber haqqerach littol mayim mittachtayv, shehare eno bore mayim bazeh, umishshum shebirat haqqerach en issur kelal, shekkol dabar talush sheeno keli — en bishbirato upesiqato shum issur kelal, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"d. Abal benahar o beer, kevan shehaqqerach mechubbar laqqarqa — asur leshabbero:

Tzarik lizzaher shello leshapshep yadayv bemelach, mippene shehammelach nimmoach al yadayv. Abal muttar lehashlik mayim bemelach velittol yadayv mehem, ap al pi shehammelach nimcheh sham meelayv, ubilbad shello yeshapshepennu beyadayv. Ubachorep tzarik shello littol yadayv kelal bemayim sheyyesh bahem sheleg o barad, shehemma qallim lehitrasseq mehammelach. Veim yittol — yizzaher shello yidchaqem ben yadayv, shello yehe merasseq beyadayim. Veyesh omerim shekkol shehannimmoach eno been lebaddo ella mitareb bedabar acher, apillu merasseqo umemachehu beyadayim — muttar. Velaken muttar littol yadayv uleshapshepam bemayim sheyyesh bahem sheleg ubarad o melach, ap al pi shemmerasseqem umemacheh otam beyadayv, kevan shehem mitorbim bemayim sheal yadayv. Veken muttar apillu lerasseq beyadayim chatikot sheleg ubarad sheyyehe nimcheh vezab letok kos shel yayin o mayim, mippene shettaam issur harissuq beyadayim hu mishshum gezera shemma yischot perot haomedim lemashqin, lepi shehashsheleg vehabbarad lememehen hen omedim, vekevan shehu mitareb bedabar acher — lo gazeru, lepi sheeno domeh lischitat perot haomedim lemashqin, shehammashqeh hannischat hu been lebaddo. Veyesh lehachamir kasbara harishona:

Ulepikak, yesh mi shehaya nizhar lehatil mayim bashsheleg, ki al yede hashsheten nimmoach hashsheleg, vahare zeh kimemachehu beyadayim, sheasur lepi sebara harishona ap al pi sheen hannimmoach been lebaddo (vegam hu holek leibbud). Abal muttar lidros sheleg beraglayv, ki epshar shello yehe nimcheh venames al yede kak, velaken ap im hu nimcheh venames — dabar sheeno mitkavven hu, umuttar kevan sheeno "pesiq resheh". Veyesh mi sheomer sheapillu hamminalim lachim ubevadday nimmas hashsheleg sham — muttar. Veken muttar lehatil me raglayim bashsheleg, mippene shehu dabar shei epshar lizzaher bo bimot hachorep ki kol haaretz melea sheleg, velaken lo gazeru bo chakamim kelal. (Vetob lehachamir bemaqom sheepshar lizzaher beqal):

Asur lipros sudar al pi chabit shel mayim lekassotah, shemma yitlaklek bemayim veyabo lesochoto veyitchayyeb mishshum melabben. Abal beged heasuy lipros aleha — muttar, mippene sheeno choshesh alayv lesochoto im mitlaklek, kevan shehu meyuchad lekak. Abal muttar lipros sudar al pi chabit shel yayin adom o shel shemen o shekar ushear mashqim kayyotze bahem. Vaapillu lishroto lekattechilla bemashqin hallalu beyadayim, kegon lesanneno alayv — muttar, mippene sheen melabben ella mayim veyayin laban vekayyotze bahem. Umikkol maqom, beged shennishreh, apillu bemashqin sheen melabbenin — asur lesochoto, mishshum issur mepareq shehu toledet haddash, kemo shessechitat perot asura mishshum mepareq, ella sheeno chayyab al sechita zo ella im ken tzarik lemashqin hannischatin mehabbeged. Abal im eno tzarik lemashqin hannischatin, veeno sochet ella kede lenaqqot habbeged — en zeh domeh ledisha kelal, shehaddash hu tzarik litbua shemmepareq mehashshibbolim, lepikak en bischita zo issur min hattora ella middibre soperim. Velaken lo gazeru shello lishrot beged bemashqin sheen melabbenim, mishshum gezera shemma yischot veyitchayyeb mishshum mepareq, kevan sheeno chayyab ella im ken tzarik lemashqin hannischatin, vezeh en lachush kelal sheyyischot habbeged letzorek hammashqin sheyyissachatu mimmennu, mippene sheenan chashubim kelum, veen derek kelal laasot ken:

Asur lahadoq mokin bepi pak sheyyesh bo mashqin, shemma yabo lide sechita, sheal yede hahidduq yissachatu hammashqin habbeluin bammokin letok happak. Veap sheeno mitkavven, mikkol maqom "pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu kesheyyehaddeq heteb, velaken aseru lehaddeq kelal shemma yehaddeq heteb:

Sepog, im yesh lo bet achiza shel or sheyyochazennu bo — meqannechin bo, veim lav — en meqannechin bo, shekkesheochazo beyado hu nischat ben etzbeotayv. Veap sheeno mitkavven lekak — "pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu. Veyesh mi sheomer sheap kesheyyesh lo bet achiza i epshar leqanneach bispog belo sechita, veap al pi ken muttar, shekkevan shehassechita baa al yede bet achiza — enah niqret sechita, ella hare hu kemeriq mayim mitztzelochit, sheen bo mishshum mepareq. Abal kesheen lo bet achiza, shehu nischat bimqom achizat yado —asur:

Barza shemmaknisin banneqeb shebbedopen hechabit shemmotziin bo hayyayin, vekorekin sebib habbarza chatikat beged o neoret shel pishtan upoqeqim bah hanneqeb shebbechabit — asur lipqoq bah beshabbat, apillu hi chabit shel yayin adom o shear mashqin sheen melabbenim, mippene sheal yede happeqiqa nischatin mashqin habbeluin binoret, u"pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu. Veap shehammashqin hannischatin holekin leibbud, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veyesh omerim shekkol shehammashqin holekin leibbud — en issur apillu middibre soperim ella keshemmitkavven lischot, abal kol sheeno mekavven lekak, ap al pi shehu "pesiq resheh" — muttar, kevan sheen hassechita nocha lo kelal, shehare en lo shum hanaa mimmenna. Velo aseru lehadeq mokin bepi happak ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lischot, ella mippene shehammashqin hannischatin mehammokin letok happak shemmaggia lo hanaa missechita zo, abal mashqin hannischatin mehanneoret shessebib habbarza hen holekin leibbud im en keli tachtehem, veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum. Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona, shehare sepog sheen lo bet achiza en meqannechin bo, ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lischot vehammashqeh hannischat mehassepog holek leibbud. Umikkol maqom, haolam nahagu hetter baddabar lipqoq binoret beshabbat. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut, dekevan shehabbarza arukka chutz lanneoret veen yad maggaat lanneoret, ap al pi shennischatin mashqim min hanneoret — muttar, kemo sepog sheyyesh lo bet achiza, ledibre haomer sheap she(h)nischat mimmennu mashqeh muttar, mippene shehu kemeriq mayim mitztzelochit. Ulepi zeh ap im yesh keli tachat habbarza leqabbel mashqeh hannischat — muttar. Ulepi sherabbu hacholeqim al debarayv, laken yesh lehanhigam shello yihyeh keli tachat habbarza kede shehammashqeh hannischat yelek leibbud, veyismeku al sebara haacharona shennitbaer, ap sheenah iqqar, mippene sheyyesh mattirin legamre apillu lischot bemitkavven kol shehammashqeh holek leibbud. Vegam habbarza tehe arukka chutz lanneoret, kede letzarep gam ken qula zo. (Umishshum issur libbun en lachush binoret ubachatikat beged shessebib habbarza, ap im hu yayin laban shehu melabben, mippene shehen asuyin lekak veeno choshesh lelibbun kelal, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"t leinyan meshammeret):

Poqeqin et habbib besudarin ubekol dabar hammittaltel kede shello yatzupu hammayim al hookalin veal hakkelim, lepi sheeno choshesh im yetzeu mayim muatim, lepikak eno docheq harbeh, velo yabo lide sechita bi"pesiq resheh":
Muttar litten karkom battabshil, veen lachush mishshum tzobea, sheen tzebia bookalim:

Haokel tutim o shear perot hatztzebuim — tzarik lizzaher shello yigga beyadayv tzebuot bibgadayv o bemappa, mishshum issur tzebia. Veap al pi shemmeqalqel hu vekol hamqalqelin peturim — mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim. Veyesh meqillin, mishshum sheeno ella derek likluk, veen bo mishshum tzobea kelal. Veyesh lehachamir, vekol shekken bebeged adom sheeno mitqalqel kelal. Abal im tzobea pitto bemashqeh happerot — en bekak kelum, sheen tzebia bookalin. Veken mah shetztzobea bahem panayv veyadayv — en lachush kelal, sheen tzebia ella bedabar sheddarko letzobo. Velo aseru leishsha lehaabir seraq al paneha mishshum tzobea, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"g, ella mippene shehaishsha darkah bekak. Veken likchol et haenayim, sheaseru ben leish ben leishsha mishshum tzobea, mippene sheddarkam bekak:

In issur min hattora ella hatztzobea betzeba hammitqayyem. Abal tzeba sheeno mitqayyem kelal, kegon sheheebir shashar o seraq al gabbe barzel unechoshet utzebao — patur, shehare atta maabiro lishato, veeno tzobe kelum. Umikkol maqom, asur middibre soperim:
